title: Vlada Bortnik endorses Incorruptible
summary: Bortnik founded Marco Polo and is its CEO. Her endorsement is among the blurbs on incorruptible.co.
blockquote: Incorruptible is not just a book. It's permission. It's a blueprint. And it's proof that you're not crazy for wanting to build something that's both wildly successful and deeply good, something that lasts. For any founder who truly wants to make a difference, this is a must read.
attribution_title: Founder and CEO of Marco Polo
